scheme_name: Rani Durgavati and Shankarshah Puraskar Scheme (Reward Scheme for Meritorious Students)
other_conditions: Applicant must be enrolled in Class 10th or 12th
Applicant must be selected based on the merit list of the 10th and 12th board examinations conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Madhya Pradesh
benefits_summary: Cash awards ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹51,000 for the top six meritorious students in 10th and 12th standards.
